llm_metadata.reasoning: Rebuilt the ul_bler component using a hybrid direct and residual ensemble with HistGradientBoostingRegressor models trained on relevant wireless physical layer metrics (PUSCH/PUCCH SNR, UL MCS, PHR, UL throughput, PRBs, and lag features). The ensemble effectively captures transient error rate spikes while clipping predictions to standard ratio boundaries [0, 1].

Corrected base class import from ResidualDTComponent to DTComponent (from src.dt_models.base import DTComponent). Adjusted HistGradientBoostingRegressor parameters (250 iterations, learning_rate 0.03, max_depth 6, L2 regularization 0.05) and targeted uplink feature set to optimize prediction accuracy and ensure fidelity improvement over baseline.

Rebuilt UlBlerModel using a dual-path ensemble strategy combining residual learning on top of ul_bler_lag1 with a direct gradient boosting model. Utilizes HistGradientBoostingRegressor and ExtraTreesRegressor across key RF indicators (PUSCH/PUCCH SNR, UL MCS, Power Headroom, PRBs) and historical BLER lags, while enforcing strict domain boundary clipping [0.0, 1.0].

Rebuilt the ul_bler candidate component using an ensemble of HistGradientBoostingRegressor models trained on target UL BLER values with targeted UL feature selection (PUSCH SNR, PUCCH SNR, UL MCS, PHR, UL throughput, and lag/roll terms) alongside engineered short-term delta features to overcome earlier candidate rejection and improve fidelity tracking.

Rebuilt UlBlerModel component using HistGradientBoostingRegressor tailored for UL BLER target prediction. Selected domain-focused lag features, SNR, MCS, and PHR metrics for optimal feature signal and strict [0.0, 1.0] prediction bounds.

Rebuilt the DlRlcDelayModel using HistGradientBoostingRegressor to better capture nonlinear relationships between RLC queue delay, predicted DL throughput, predicted DL BLER, and historical lag/rolling indicators. Added explicit non-negativity clipping for delay predictions and robust handling of missing values.
